description: A tiny ESP32-C5 app image (esptool 5.6.0 ESP32C5FirmwareImage, two segments, SHA-256 appended), signed with espsecure 5.6.0 sign-data --version 2 (RSA-3072) by a test key and by another key (neither private key is kept). Digests from espsecure digest-sbv2-public-key. Test key only: never a kit's.
